_note: Port of design/marketing/Professional Tools.dc.html at /for-experts/tools — a page the extracted seeds never covered because the design file is new (nothing in the site linked to it). Prices are NOT here: the three dark tier cards in the #join section read payments.SubscriptionPlan group 'pricing-page', the same rows the /for-experts/pricing table uses, so the two pages can never disagree. Block choices: the before/after panels are value_props groups 'chasing' and 'doing' — title-only rows, since the design renders each line as a single bullet with no body. The seven alternating feature rows are personas group 'features': Persona is the only block with a points[] list, which is exactly the three 'what you get' bullets, and kicker/title/body land 1:1. Two Persona fields are repurposed and named in the design's terms: cta_label carries the row's payoff line (the green THE PAYOFF chip) and cta_href carries the image caption pill — the same documented repurposing project-gallery.json uses for CaseCard.location. Each row's image comes from MediaAsset slot 'professional-tools:ft-*' (the design's own image-slot ids, in row order) and its icon from the page's inline icon set, both keyed by position like the landing page's StepArt. The platform takes 0% and clients pay the professional directly — no funds ever pass through us.

copy.text: One platform to run your whole practice.
Clients, your profile, scheduling, proposals and the answers you need for any city — all in one place. Spend your time designing, not chasing work.
Briefed & pre-qualified · ready to book a call
One subscription. Each piece earns its place.
Pick a plan and bring your skill
A flat monthly fee — never a cut of your work. Apply free; subscribe once you're live. Cancel anytime.

value_props.title: Cold-pitching and hunting for the next job between projects
Guessing at the rules when a client is in a city you don’t know
Losing leads because you replied a day too late
Starting every proposal from a blank page
Your work scattered across email, a website you never update, and sticky notes
Briefed, pre-qualified clients arrive in your dashboard
Instant answers on submittal rules and timelines for any city
Every new match gets an instant reply in your voice
Proposals that start pre-filled from the client’s brief
One clean profile, one pipeline, one login for all of it

personas.title: A steady flow of clients who want you
personas.body: We match you with owners whose projects fit your disciplines, licensure and capacity — and hand them over already briefed. No cold outreach, no bidding wars.
personas.points:
Scoped project matches in your specialties
Only clients you’re actually a fit for
You set your rate — hire and invoice them directly

personas.title: A profile that sells while you sleep
personas.body: A clean, public page with your portfolio, disciplines, licensure and rates. Put the link in your email signature and social bio — it works as your website and gets you found.
personas.points:
Portfolio, credentials and rates in one page
A shareable link you’re proud to send
Found by the owners searching in your area

personas.title: Never lose a client to a slow reply
personas.body: The moment a match lands, an on-brand reply goes out in your voice — acknowledging the project and offering times. You look responsive even when you’re heads-down on a deadline.
personas.points:
Automatic first response, every time
Written in your own tone
Offers times and opens the conversation
personas.cta_label: Win the clients who go with whoever answers first

personas.title: Take work in any city with confidence
personas.body: Look up exactly what a jurisdiction requires — submittal checklist, typical plan-check timeline, local amendments and the mistakes that get projects rejected. 3,200 cities, kept current.
personas.points:
Submittal requirements by project type
Realistic plan-check timelines
Common rejection reasons, flagged upfront
personas.cta_label: Say yes to projects outside your home turf

personas.title: Let clients book you in one click
personas.body: Share your availability for consults, plan reviews and scoping calls. Clients pick a slot themselves — the back-and-forth disappears and the first conversation happens sooner.
personas.points:
Self-serve scheduling for calls
No email tag to find a time
Consults, reviews and scoping in one place
personas.cta_label: Go from “saw your profile” to “on a call” faster

personas.title: Send proposals in minutes, not evenings
personas.body: Because the client already answered the questionnaire, your proposal starts pre-filled with scope, a fair price range and the likely permit path. You review, adjust and send — it’s always yours.
personas.points:
Pre-filled scope, pricing and permit path
Edit and brand it as your own
Send a polished proposal same day
personas.cta_label: Win more work with less admin

personas.title: See every opportunity in one board
personas.body: All your active pursuits and projects on one simple board, plus a shared timeline your clients can follow. Fewer “where are we?” emails, and nothing slips through the cracks.
personas.points:
Every pursuit and project at a glance
Shared client-update timelines
Know what needs your attention next
personas.cta_label: Run more work without dropping a ball
